summary: @servicetitan/tanstack-query-mobx ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, then invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, obfuscated with a string-array rotator (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())... }` over a large mixed-type table `n7gIxM`) and randomized hex identifiers, with no source maps. The Node preinstall step only fetches and launches the alternate runtime; the actual payload executes under Bun, bypassing Node-based scanners. The package is advertised as a TanStack-Query/MobX integration (homepage github.com/servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib), a purpose that does not require fetching a second JavaScript runtime or executing a 700KB opaque bundle at install time. The name occupies the @servicetitan npm scope, so any consumer that runs `npm install` on this package receives arbitrary code execution under Bun with no relationship to the advertised functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
